editorial_intro: Samantha Ruth Prabhu's blockbuster Maa Inti Bangaaram hits JioHotstar this week. Will Ferrell swings for Netflix comedy gold in The Hawk, Raktanchal returns bloodier than ever on Prime Video, and Emerald Fennell reimagines Wuthering Heights with Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi.

picks.title: Maa Inti Bangaaram
picks.synopsis: Samantha Ruth Prabhu stars as Swarna, a former assassin seeking a peaceful life who marries into a conservative family. When she visits her husband's village for a wedding, she must win over skeptical in-laws while secretly protecting them from violent enemies from her past. The highest-grossing solo female-led Telugu film of all time.
picks.why_watch: The year's biggest Telugu blockbuster — a 100-crore hit — finally lands on streaming. Samantha at her action-comedy best.

picks.title: Raktanchal Season 3
picks.synopsis: The brutal gang war shifts from Purvanchal to Lucknow's political corridors in the early 2000s. As state assembly elections loom, Vijay Singh attempts to dismantle the mafia from within by running for public office, while his arch-nemesis Waseem Khan forms dangerous new political alliances for ultimate control of Uttar Pradesh.
picks.why_watch: One of India's grittiest crime series is back — if you liked Mirzapur, Raktanchal goes even darker.

picks.title: Wuthering Heights
picks.synopsis: Emerald Fennell (Saltburn, Promising Young Woman) directs this passionate reimagining of Emily Brontë's classic. Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi star as Catherine and Heathcliff in a visually stunning exploration of their intense, destructive love on the Yorkshire moors.
picks.why_watch: Emerald Fennell directing Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi in a gothic romance — the prestige event of the week.

picks.title: The Hawk
picks.synopsis: Will Ferrell plays Lonnie 'The Hawk' Hawkins, a formerly celebrated golf prodigy whose career was derailed by his antics and temper. Washed up and desperate, he drags his dysfunctional family on a chaotic cross-country road trip for one last shot at golf's Grand Slam, balancing his massive ego on the green with fatherhood off it.
picks.why_watch: Will Ferrell doing what he does best — an over-the-top sports comedy in the Happy Gilmore tradition.

picks.title: Heartstopper Forever
picks.synopsis: The final chapter of the beloved series. Nick and Charlie face their biggest hurdle yet as Nick prepares to move away for university while Charlie discovers new independence at school. As doubts creep in about whether first loves can withstand adulthood, their friend circle navigates the bittersweet trials of growing up.
picks.why_watch: The finale of one of Netflix's most beloved YA series — bring tissues.

picks.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
picks.synopsis: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn. More high-stakes hide-and-seek and dark humor from the cult favorite franchise.
picks.why_watch: The original was a cult hit — the sequel doubles down on the dark fun with an expanded mythology.

picks.title: Ride or Die
picks.synopsis: Two lifelong best friends discover one of them has been living a secret double life as an international assassin. When a hit goes sideways and a dangerous figure reemerges, they're forced on a chaotic, continent-crossing run dodging armed law enforcement, rival killers, and criminal syndicates across Europe.
picks.why_watch: Hannah Waddingham as a secret assassin, Bill Nighy being Bill Nighy — this could be the week's most fun surprise.

picks.title: Spooky in Love
picks.synopsis: A hotel CEO cursed with seeing restless spirits teams up with an ace prosecutor terrified of ghosts. When they discover they unlock unique abilities by touching, the mismatched pair investigates unsolved murders while unexpectedly falling in love. Park Eun-bin's first K-drama since Extraordinary Attorney Woo.
picks.why_watch: Park Eun-bin returns to K-drama — her track record is near-perfect, and the ghost-romance premise is irresistible.

picks.title: The East Palace
picks.synopsis: A dark fantasy period drama where an arrogant ghost-slaying swordsman and a palace court lady cursed to hear the dead are hired to clear vengeful spirits threatening the Crown Prince. Together they navigate royal power plays, dangerous secrets, and an unimaginable world of darkness.
picks.why_watch: Gorgeous period-horror from Korea — swords, ghosts, and palace intrigue in one stunning package.

picks.title: 23,000 Lives
picks.synopsis: Based on a true story — a group of passionate young Berliners crowdfund an old ship to rescue refugees in the Mediterranean, turning their humanitarian mission into a test of their beliefs about law, justice, and human compassion.
picks.why_watch: Louis Hofmann (Dark) in a powerful true-story drama about ordinary people doing extraordinary things.
